caption: Two abstract pigment routes explain why cholestasis can cause pale stools and dark urine.
question: Why can cholestasis make stool pale while urine becomes dark?
answer: Less bile pigment reaches stool, while water-soluble conjugated bilirubin accumulates in blood and is excreted in urine.
